text:
You need someone who can proofread pharmaceutical marketing and promotional materials carefully, compare against changes, and catch every issue in Adobe PDFs within a fast turnaround.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience working with Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. While my background is technical, the core of my work has always depended on the same habits you’re asking for here: close attention to detail, organized review, and a methodical approach to spotting inconsistencies, typos, and missing pieces.

One relevant project was **Product recommendations** for **Tidewater Outfitters**. I built **similar items and “you-may-also-like” carousels** trained on **1.2M interactions** and cached in Redis. In a **4-week A/B test**, that work delivered a **14% click-through rate increase**. That project required disciplined review of inputs, consistency across outputs, and careful validation before release.

For your pharma and device materials, I would approach each PDF as a quality-control pass: checking the changes, reading for sense and typos, and calling out anything else that stands out. I’m comfortable working through detailed material, keeping track of revisions, and making sure the final version is clean and consistent. If a piece needs deeper review because it involves prescribing information, a white paper, or references, I understand that it will take more time and a more careful read.

I also understand the importance of tone, grammar, and precision in regulated marketing content. Even small wording issues can matter, so I’d be focused on catching them before anything goes out the door. If you need someone who can be thorough, organized, and persistent about getting the details right, I’d be glad to help.

What kinds of PDFs do you send most often—simple markups and typos, or more detailed pieces with prescribing information and references?
